description: This file defines a function to initialize a build watcher UI component for Next.js development, including DOM manipulation, event handling, and dynamic CSS creation.

methods.name: initializeBuildWatcher
methods.description: Sets up a build status indicator in the DOM, listens for build events, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: createContainer
methods.description: Creates and returns the DOM element for the build watcher container with embedded SVG icon.

methods.name: createCss
methods.description: Generates and returns a style element with CSS rules for the build watcher UI, using a prefix for class names.
